titulo: The Lost Little Sheep 🐑 | Bible Story for Kids #shorts
descricao:
The good shepherd had a hundred sheep, and one got lost. He left the ninety-nine and searched until he found it! A parable of Jesus. A Bible story A parable of Jesus told by Mel the little sheep for kids ages 3 to 6.

📖 Reference: Luke 15
💛 Lesson: You are very important to God. He never gives up on you.
licao: God looks for each one of us

falas.texto: Hi, little friend! This story is about a little sheep, just like me!
Jesus told a very beautiful story.
A shepherd had a hundred sheep. He knew every one!
Ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine... Oh! One is missing!
Stay here. I'll go look for my little sheep!
Far away on the mountain, the little sheep was alone.
The shepherd climbed up and down, looking everywhere.
I found you! Come here, little one!
He put the little sheep on his shoulders and came back singing.
Friends, celebrate with me! I found my sheep!
You are very important to God. He never gives up on you!
Bye-bye, little friend! God loves you!
